variables.input:
fetch spans, from:-24h
| filter span.kind == "server"
| summarize count(), by:{ service.name }
| fields service.name

1.content:
## $service · Service (L1)
SLO → RED → per client → per version → saturation. Template owned by SRE (Monaco).

2.title: Requests
2.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == $service and span.kind == "server"
| makeTimeseries requests = count()

3.title: Error ratio
3.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == $service and span.kind == "server"
| makeTimeseries { total = count(), errors = countIf(http.response.status_code >= 500) }
| fieldsAdd error_ratio = errors[] / total[]
| fields timeframe, interval, error_ratio

4.title: Per client
4.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == $service and span.kind == "server"
| summarize requests = count(), errors = countIf(http.response.status_code >= 500), by:{ client.id }
| fieldsAdd error_pct = 100 * errors / requests
| sort error_pct desc

5.title: Error ratio by version
5.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == $service and span.kind == "server"
| makeTimeseries { total = count(), errors = countIf(http.response.status_code >= 500) }, by:{ service.version }
| fieldsAdd error_ratio = errors[] / total[]
| fields timeframe, interval, service.version, error_ratio
